statement: In the Gaussian zero-temperature model of arXiv:0810.4221v2 Section 8, let g_v be iid N(0,1) on Z_+^2 and M_n=max_p sum_{v in p} g_v, where p has n vertices, starts at the origin, moves up or right, and has unrestricted endpoint. Theorem 8.1 proves Var(M_n)<=C n/log n. A precise power-improvement formulation of Section 12(3) asks whether there exist epsilon>0,C<infinity,n_0 such that Var(M_n)<=C n^(1-epsilon) for all n>=n_0. This formulation is a scoped reading of the exponent question; the cited theorem is not a positive-temperature log-Z bound in general dimension.
